entities.summary: Albert Heinrich Brendel was a painter most famous for his depictions of animals in a rural setting. He studied in the Prussian Academy of Arts under Wilhelm Krause. In 1851 he went to Paris, and studied under Couture and Palizzi; thence to Italy, and home to Berlin in 1853, completing his studies under Carl Steffeck.
